summary: The phase does what D1 to D5 and FR-1 to FR-4 state. `phaseStartDecision` is now `phaseStartNote`, and the three closeout functions return its text as a note with no decision. No adapter can deny a task status change in `plan.md`, and each adapter gives the note only to a call that did not fail. The track-close part did not change. No code caller of the old name remains. Each plugin parity check prints `parity: ok`. The three test files assert the exact D2 text, and the Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` state the new behavior. The phase has 3 Nit findings and no Blocker or Major.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] measure/tracks/guard_phase_start_20261109/plan.md:31: the plan says "5 mutant runs of the new lines, each killed", but `green-p3-mutants.log` records "MUTANT a note with a checkpoint: SURVIVED". Rationale: the next sentence explains the survivor, but the claim as written contradicts its own evidence log; write "4 killed, 1 survived (OpenCode copy)".

F2 [Nit] plugins/dsh-measure-guard/src/guard.js:110-111: the changed docstring of `closeoutGuardFor` still says that "the core's `[b]` note is returned for the post-execute append", but a `plan.md` edit now returns the phase-start note on that channel.
